attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Tennessee state income tax per hypothetical Form TN-1040. Tennessee uses progressive tax brackets: 2% on first $50,000, 4% on $50,000-$100,000, 6% above $100,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($6,000 Single, $12,000 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.
